row.title: An outage is not the item's failure: no-route, dispositions, and recall of earlier failures
row.body: Measured 2026-11-27: 549 of 592 failed executor rows were provider outages (all rungs 502, or the retired GitHub Models route) recorded as bad replies, spending three attempts and labelling the item executor-failed. NO-ROUTE-1 ends such a run as no-route (deferred_budget) and releases the claim; ladderwatch reads no-route rows. DISPOSITION-1 maps every executor result to one of five dispositions and refuses a self-verified done; FLAG-1 records a contradiction instead of forcing a pass; earlier failures of an item go into its next prompt (failure_recall 0.968).

title: An outage is not the item's failure: no-route, dispositions, and recall of earlier failures
